summary: 24 m (80 ft) heavy steel tower on the Tower hill at Anglin Lake, Saskatchewan; cabin kept as a park lodge; no build year found.

facts.design: Heavy steel tower; cupola removed in the early 2000s (field note)
facts.status_note: Based on one visitor field note dated October 2026; no agency record found.

access.note: Field note: access to the site is unrestricted, and the tower area is fenced off for safety. Park vehicle entry permit needed for year-round access.

visit.trail_note: Parking at the Anglin bridge; the tower tenting sites are about 3 km up the trail from the trailhead.

events.note: Great Blue Heron Provincial Park established from two recreation sites plus a large tract of Crown land.
Blog reports the park maintained the cabin as a first-come, first-served overnight lodge.
Field note: cabin in good condition, tower area fenced off, site unrestricted.

evidence.supports: Elevation 565 m (1,854 ft)
Field note describes a heavy steel tower, size 24 m (80 ft)
evidence.quote: The tower type is a 80' Heavy Steel.

evidence.supports: Cupola removed in the early 2000s to make room for a thermal detection system
evidence.quote: There is no copula, it was removed in the early 2000's to make room for a thermal detection system.

evidence.supports: Field note dated October 2026
Cabin remains in good condition; tower present and fenced off
evidence.quote: The lookout's cabin still remains at this site and is in good condition.

evidence.supports: Access unrestricted; tower area fenced off for safety
evidence.quote: Access to the site is unrestricted though the tower area is fenced off for safety.

evidence.supports: Campers from the park visit the site often
evidence.quote: The site is visited frequently by campers in the nearby Great Blue Heron Provincial Park.

evidence.supports: Field note says the position is off, gives a corrected position
evidence.quote: The position of this tower is off by a bit.

evidence.supports: Corrected position given in the field note
evidence.quote: The correct location is: 53°42'45.0"N 105°59'58.0"W

evidence.supports: Tower hill at Anglin Lake, where the park runs tower tenting sites
evidence.quote: The Tower tenting sites are located at the summit of the Tower hill at Anglin Lake.

evidence.supports: Tenting sites are a 3 km hike from the trailhead
evidence.quote: These tenting sites are located a 3 km hike from the trailhead.

evidence.supports: Parking at the Anglin bridge
evidence.quote: Parking is located at the Anglin bridge.

evidence.supports: Park reduced services from 1 October 2026
evidence.quote: Effective October 1, 2026, Great Blue Heron Provincial Park will have reduced services.

evidence.supports: Firewood and pit toilets available in reduced services
evidence.quote: Firewood and pit toilets will be available.

evidence.supports: No power, water or showers in reduced services
evidence.quote: Power, water, showers and the trailer dump station will not be available.

evidence.supports: Cabin was once the seasonal home of the fire tower worker at Anglin Lake
evidence.quote: this old log cabin he had heard about that was once the seasonal home to the fire tower worker at Anglin Lake

evidence.supports: The log cabin sits up on the hill
evidence.quote: we caught our first glimpse of the cabin up on the hill overlooking the forest

evidence.supports: Park maintains the cabin as a first-come, first-served overnight lodge (2018)
evidence.quote: was now maintained by Great Blue Heron Provincial Park as an overnight lodge on a first-come first-serve basis

evidence.supports: Vehicle entry permit required for year-round access
evidence.quote: Note: A vehicle entry permit is required for year-round access.

evidence.supports: Park established in 2013 from two pre-existing recreation sites and Crown land
evidence.quote: The provincial park was established in 2013 from two pre-existing provincial recreation sites

evidence.supports: Large tract of Crown land added to the park
evidence.quote: the addition of a large tract of Crown land

evidence.supports: Park about 50 km north of Prince Albert
evidence.quote: about 50 kilometres (31 mi) north of the city of Prince Albert

corrections.why: An October 2026 field note on firelookout.ca says the position is off and gives 53°42'45.0"N 105°59'58.0"W. That is about 0.7 km from the current point. Not checked on a map.

sources.title: Tower Cabin in Great Blue Heron Provincial Park
Great Blue Heron Provincial Park - Anglin Lake Trails

notes_for_editor: No source gives a build year (firelookout.ca's entry lists none), so there is no built event. Height, the 80 ft figure, cupola removal and the 2026 condition all come from one visitor field note; treat them as unverified. The coordinates correction is the same note's, not checked on a map. The 2018 cabin history is a personal blog. Brief has no local_unit and the story names none. No source names the tower's original owner or agency, so agency is left out.
